novel_features.name: Keyword pre-cleaner with 40501 surfacer
novel_features.description: Pre-clean keywords before sending to Google Ads volume so one bad keyword doesn't poison the whole batch, and surface task-level 40501 errors that DataForSEO hides behind a top-level 20000.
novel_features.rationale: Only possible because the CLI inspects the response envelope per-task and short-circuits the request before sending if any keyword fails the >10-word / punctuation rules.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when you'd otherwise call the Google Ads volume endpoint directly. DataForSEO returns top-level 20000 (success) even when every task inside failed validation; this command refuses to send poisoned batches and exits non-zero on hidden errors.

novel_features.name: Auto-mode router (Live ↔ Standard)
novel_features.description: Auto-pick the cost-optimal execution mode based on batch size via `--mode auto`. Batches of 5 or fewer go through Live (sync, premium); larger batches route through Standard (queued, ~3.3× cheaper) with a managed poll loop.
novel_features.rationale: DataForSEO's Live vs Standard cost differential is the top community complaint; no competitor MCP routes automatically — they make the user pick mode every call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use whenever the batch size is uncertain. Pass `--mode auto` (the default) to avoid burning 3.3× the cost on a 200-keyword job because the user forgot to flip to Standard.

novel_features.name: Cost estimator with pre-call confirmation gate
novel_features.description: Predict spend before any live API call using a static price table per endpoint family multiplied by the planned input size. Optional --confirm-over flag gates spending above a threshold.
novel_features.rationale: DataForSEO's pricing varies 3.3× between Live and Standard and 30× across endpoint families; no other wrapper offers pre-call cost transparency.
novel_features.example: dataforseo-pp-cli cost estimate keywords-data google-ads search-volume --keywords keywords.txt --confirm-over 1.00
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before any batch-size or backlink call. Joey's #1 fear with DataForSEO is accidentally burning the $50 deposit on one careless command; this prevents that.

novel_features.name: Standard-mode task bundler with resumable local ledger
novel_features.description: Run the full Standard-mode lifecycle (task_post → tasks_ready poll → task_get → merge) as one command, with task IDs persisted to local SQLite so Ctrl-C or a laptop sleep doesn't lose the queue.
novel_features.rationale: The task_post / tasks_ready / task_get triple is the largest UX gap in the official MCP; users self-host poll loops or use pingback callbacks they can't easily host.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for any cost-sensitive batch job (which is most of them). One command replaces a Python poll-loop script and survives interruptions.

novel_features.name: Local SQLite store + offline FTS over past results
novel_features.description: Every result-returning API call mirrors into local SQLite (keywords, serp_results, backlinks, ai_mentions) with FTS5 indexes; offline `search` runs FTS5 MATCH over snippets, URLs, anchor text, and AI-answer excerpts without re-billing.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-entity local query no single API call provides; powers every delta tracker downstream.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use whenever you're tempted to re-call the same SERP/volume/backlink endpoint. The local store makes re-queries free.

novel_features.name: Volume delta tracker
novel_features.description: Joins the current Google Ads volume API response against the last stored value per keyword in local SQLite and outputs movers sorted by absolute delta.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-source join only possible with local history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this whenever a content team asks 'which of the keywords we tracked last week moved.' DataForSEO doesn't return historical volume in one call; the local store enables this.

novel_features.name: Rank + SERP-feature delta over URL list
novel_features.description: Parse a sitemap or URL→keyword map, call `serp/google/organic/live/advanced` per keyword, diff position + SERP features (AI Overview, featured snippet, knowledge panel, PAA) against last run, and flag movers and feature gains/losses.
novel_features.rationale: Multi-endpoint local join (SERP API × URL→keyword map × historical rank) only possible with the local store; covers the Monday-morning rank-check ritual that costs $150-400/mo at Ahrefs/Semrush.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use weekly across any tracked page inventory. Replaces a manual GSC + incognito-Google ritual with one command.

novel_features.name: AI-visibility delta in LLM answers
novel_features.description: Call AI Optimization family endpoints (gemini, chat_gpt, llm_mentions, claude, perplexity) for a brand × keyword grid, store per-LLM mentions/excerpts in SQLite, and diff week-over-week presence + mention count per LLM.
novel_features.rationale: AI Optimization is a new family (36 paths) and no community wrapper diffs week-over-week; the local store enables it.
novel_features.example: dataforseo-pp-cli ai-visibility track --brand "FSM Stump Grinding" --keywords keywords.txt --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use weekly to track whether a brand's offer copy is being cited by ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity for buyer-intent queries. The mechanical alternative is asking each LLM by hand.

novel_features.name: Backlinks-since-last-run
novel_features.description: Snapshot `backlinks/summary` + `referring_domains` + `anchors` into local SQLite; on each run diff against the prior snapshot and surface newly-acquired referring domains with anchor text.
novel_features.rationale: Diff against history only possible with the local snapshot; replaces $199+/mo Ahrefs queries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use weekly during any link-acquisition campaign (citation submissions, guest posts, PR placements) to confirm new backlinks landed and anchor text is on-brand.

narrative.headline: Every DataForSEO endpoint, plus auto-mode routing, cost estimates, keyword pre-cleaning, and a local SQLite store no other DataForSEO tool has.
narrative.value_prop: A single-binary Go CLI over all 554 DataForSEO endpoints with offline SQLite-backed delta trackers, automatic Live↔Standard mode routing to dodge the 3.3× cost premium, and a pre-call cost estimator. Built to absorb everything the official MCP and the 6.4k-star claude-seo skill already do, then go further with rank tracking over a sitemap, AI-visibility deltas across ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity, and backlinks-since-last-run diffs.
narrative.auth_narrative: DataForSEO uses HTTP Basic. Set DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD from app.dataforseo.com/api-access. Run `dataforseo-pp-cli doctor` to verify the credentials and surface your account balance before kicking off any cost-bearing call.

quickstart.comment: Verify credentials and check connectivity before any cost-bearing call.
Predict spend before a volume call so a 200-keyword batch doesn't surprise-bill you.
Pre-clean the keyword list so one over-10-word string doesn't fail the whole batch with the silent 40501 trap.
Same call with a spend cap. Exits non-zero (code 7) if predicted cost exceeds $1; pipe success into the live volume call (which reads JSON via --stdin).
Weekly Monday-morning rank check over a sitemap, with SERP-feature deltas (AI Overview, featured snippet) flagged.

quickstart.command: dataforseo-pp-cli ai-visibility track --brand "FSM Stump Grinding" --keywords keywords.txt --json
quickstart.comment: Track brand mentions in ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Perplexity answers, week-over-week.

troubleshoots.symptom: Top-level status_code 20000 but every keyword volume is null
troubleshoots.fix: Task-level 40501 — one keyword failed validation. Re-run with `keywords clean <file>` first to filter strings over 10 words or with punctuation.

troubleshoots.symptom: Live Google Ads call returns HTTP 429
troubleshoots.fix: Hit the 12/min Live Google Ads limit. Add `--rate-limit 12rpm` or switch to the task-post variant via `task bundle`.
`tasks_ready` has a refresh delay on >1000 tasks/min. Use `dataforseo-pp-cli task list` to inspect the local ledger and `task get <id>` to fetch any single result.
Run `cost estimate <endpoint-path>` before any batch call. Add `--confirm-over 1.00` to gate any command above $1.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for dataforseo-pp-cli whenever an SEO workflow touches DataForSEO endpoints — keyword volume hydration, SERP scraping, backlink audits, AI-search visibility tracking, on-page audits. Pick it over the official MCP when you want offline search over past results, automatic Live↔Standard cost routing, or a one-command Standard-mode poll loop. Pick it over the Python/TS clients when you want a single static binary on a server, a Cobra-style command tree, or `--dry-run` + `--cost-estimate` safety before billing.

recipes.title: Weekly rank check for an entire site
recipes.explanation: Pulls each URL's target keyword from the sitemap, calls SERP per keyword, diffs vs last week's local snapshot, and surfaces movers and SERP-feature gains/losses.

recipes.title: Pre-call cost gating before any batch endpoint
recipes.explanation: Returns the estimated cost as JSON and exits with code 7 if it exceeds the threshold. Wrap in a shell `&&` chain to gate the actual `backlinks new --domain <domain>` call. Replaces ad-hoc Ahrefs queries for new-citation confirmation.

recipes.title: Volume hydration for ContentBot pipeline
recipes.explanation: Pre-cleans the candidate list (dropping strings over 10 words or with punctuation that would trigger the silent 40501 trap) and emits the kept list. Pipe into `keywords-data google-ads-search-volume-live --stdin --json` for the actual volume call.

recipes.title: AI brand visibility weekly diff
recipes.command: dataforseo-pp-cli ai-visibility track --brand "FSM Stump Grinding" --keywords keywords.txt --json
recipes.explanation: One row per LLM x keyword with the week-over-week mention-count delta. The local SQLite store enables the diff; no competitor MCP offers this.

recipes.title: List in-flight Standard-mode tasks
recipes.explanation: Show every task_id submitted via `task bundle` from local ledger. Use `task get <id>` to fetch any individual result later if `task bundle`'s poll loop was interrupted.
